project_type: React + Three.js game (JailBreak) with Vite build system
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit to check for type errors. 2. Run npm run build to verify the project builds successfully.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/index.html is a single-file build output, not checked in for this workflow
environment_constraints: Network mode needs to support npm install from registry. No Docker needed. The project source is at /projects/sandbox/JailBreak-v0-9/extracted/JailBreak-v0-9-optimize-editor-v2/ and git root is at /projects/sandbox/JailBreak-v0-9/
key_patterns: EditorApp.tsx has a fully working terminal UI with desktop/cameras/doors views, taskbar, and JailBreak watermark. GameUI.tsx is the main game HUD that is missing these features. The terminal system uses CameraSystemState.terminalView to track which view is active ('desktop' | 'cameras' | 'doors'). PlaytestMode has openTerminalApp/backToTerminalDesktop methods. Game.ts lacks these methods. App.tsx passes cameraState to GameUI but no terminal navigation callbacks.
directory_structure: src/components/ - React UI components, src/game/ - game systems (Three.js), src/editor/ - map editor with playtest mode
